headline: Chilean Beverage Maker CCU Reports 5% Rise in Third-Quarter Profit
summary: Chilean drinks manufacturer CCU earned approximately $16.6 million in the third quarter, representing a 5% increase as sales grew 15.5% on higher prices and volumes.
why: Earnings reports from major regional beverage producers provide insights into consumer spending resilience, pricing power, and inflationary pressures in Latin American markets.

impacts.name: CCU
impacts.why: CCU reported higher net income and increased sales volume and pricing.
